tasks.title: Room-scoped line filtering in FGPL (keep the per-pano seed)
tasks.verify: multiroom_pose_estimation filters 3D lines by the seed's room_label instead of the pano-Voronoi, KEEPING the per-pano seed for position; re-run manhattan_upright -> rotation locked > 15/22 with no translation regression
tasks.notes: The untested middle between the two refuted extremes. 22-seed Voronoi starves each pano of geometry (-> yaw aliasing); removing the partition entirely (per-room global mode) loses the position constraint and is WORSE (PERROOM_RESULTS.md: fafa0629 locked 0.7deg but 8.8m down the hallway). Room-scoped filtering keeps BOTH: whole-room geometry AND a pinned position. Needs room_label, which PanoPin already sends and FGPL only prints (D34). Even odds -- write a falsifiable prediction BEFORE running (it caught both of today's errors).

tasks.title: Ship the rotation-margin confidence signal in FGPL
tasks.verify: multiroom_pose_estimation emits a per-pose rotation margin (best minus best-of-other-rot_idx n_tight) into local_filter_results.json; margin >= 13 certifies good poses with zero false positives on the manhattan arms
tasks.notes: Detects what neither fix cures: 42/44 separation, ZERO false positives (good margins 3-56, aliased 0-11; several aliased poses have margin 0 = an exact tie broken arbitrarily by the sort). Computed WITHIN a pano so it avoids the absolute-threshold calibration trap that sank tau=0.10. multiroom_pose_estimation.py:471 already computes every candidate's n_tight and discards the runner-up; rot_idx is on top_poses[i]. Threshold 13 is tuned on one scene -- validate elsewhere.
